[[Chest of the Hero (exotic)|Chest of the Hero]] is a reward for [[daily]] [[PvE]] achievements.

== Acquisition ==
{{achievement list|reward=Chest of the Hero (exotic)}}

== Contents ==
* {{contains|Resonating Sliver|chance=Guaranteed}}
* {{contains|Sip of Liquid Karma|chance=Guaranteed}}
* {{contains|Writ of Experience|qty=2|chance=Guaranteed}}

== Trivia ==
* Added to the game with the [[Game updates/2014-12-16|December 16, 2014]] update, as part of the reworked daily achievement system.
* At the release of the reworked daily achievement system, the item's description incorrectly stated that it granted ''Scrolls of Experience'' instead of [[Writ of Experience|Writs of Experience]]. A ''Scroll of Experience'' never existed in the game.
